policy: Raw country records and legacy work keys remain unchanged. A reviewed alias may disambiguate article-to-book matching only when every author-title match resolves to one canonical writer key and exactly one matching book belongs to that canonical key.

aliases.reason: Both repository records describe the same Klagenfurt-born Austrian writer. The Austria key is the canonical country placement; the Germany key is retained as a legacy duplicate.

evidence.finding: The official estate record identifies Robert Musil by the same 1880-1942 dates, records his birth in Klagenfurt and attributes the unfinished novel Der Mann ohne Eigenschaften to him.
The specialist institute's critical-edition project identifies Der Mann ohne Eigenschaften as Robert Musil's unfinished novel and is based in his Austrian birthplace, Klagenfurt.

evidence.provider: MUSIL ONLINE, Robert-Musil-Institut and Österreichische Nationalbibliothek
evidence.finding: The joint scholarly portal identifies Robert Musil, born in Klagenfurt in 1880, as the author of Der Mann ohne Eigenschaften and describes his oeuvre as Austria's contribution to twentieth-century world literature.
